title: POV:

Someone turned the Sahara
into a parking lot.
subs: In 2031, the world officially ran out of parking.
In twenty thirty-one, the world officially ran out of parking.
So someone paved the Sahara.
Nine million square kilometers. Forty billion spaces.
Painting the lines took three years.
On opening day, it was full by noon.
Drivers circled for weeks looking for a spot.
Some of them gave up and moved in.
Row K-4000 is now a small town.
Row K, four thousand, is now a small town.
Camels were hired as shuttle buses.
They charge by the dune.
Then the sand started blowing back in.
Every morning, the cars are buried again.
The parking lot now needs its own parking lot.
For the shovels.
Last week, a man finally found a free spot.
It was right next to his own car.
He had parked there in 2031.
He had parked there, in twenty thirty-one.

hook.say: Someone paved the entire Sahara. For parking.
